title: Swiss SMBs Are Being Sold "AI Marketing." Here's How to Tell If It's Real.
note: Render on the Mac: BlogAnnounce.tsx + the cloned voice. Output blog-announce-video.mp4 into this folder.

beats.vo: Every agency in Switzerland says they use AI now.
But most cannot tell you which part of the work it actually does.
Switzerland is also not a single-language market — that matters more than you think.
Ask: which tasks does AI handle, and what does a human review before it goes live?
A genuine answer is fast and specific. Vague answers are the red flag.
The full buyer's guide is linked in the comments — go read it before you sign.
